components.css: .ds-traffic{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:8px;background:#dedede}.ds-traffic button{border-radius:50%;width:13px;height:13px;min-height:13px;padding:0;border:1px solid #0005;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #fff9,0 1px 1px #0003;font:10px/1 Arial;cursor:pointer}.ds-red{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#ffdfd4,#f45e53 60%,#c53b35)}.ds-yellow{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#fff8bd,#f5c948 60%,#c29b28)}.ds-green{background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#d8ffbd,#7fc94c 60%,#4d9227)}.ds-traffic button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3c82da;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: dock item
components.description: translucent dock with running indicator and original purple application mark.
components.css: .ds-dock{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:64px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid #ffffffa6;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(#e0e6ff99,#a5abc766);box-shadow:inset 0 1px #fff9,0 4px 15px #09092155;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);width:max-content}.ds-dock button{position:relative;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;width:49px;height:49px;padding:5px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s ease-out}.ds-dock button:hover{transform:translateY(-7px) scale(1.18)}.ds-dock button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3c82da;outline-offset:1px}.ds-dock i{position:absolute;bottom:-5px;left:23px;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#17224b;box-shadow:0 1px #fff8}

narrative.northStar: a secret inside an old computer
narrative.overview: the approved desktop identity is aqua macos: a blue-purple wallpaper, a top menu, silver rounded windows, colored traffic-light controls, and a translucent magnifying dock. original purple application icons distinguish this fictional computer. the mystery remains inside messages, photographs, records, and the camera archive.
keyCharacteristics: independent overlapping applications with internal scrolling.
centered silver title bars and red, yellow, green window controls.
top menu and bottom dock instead of a taskbar.
compact lowercase copy and full-screen active applications on phones.
dos: do preserve the approved aqua menu, dock, traffic lights, and silver chrome.
do keep scrolling within applications and the desktop within the viewport.
do retain original purple icons and the compact application scale.
do pair visual state with accessible text or semantic control state.
donts: don't restore the discarded teal desktop, navy title bars, or bottom taskbar.
don't add an outer game dashboard or large promotional headings.
don't require precise dragging, audio, or external research to solve a chapter.
